mode_string_timestamp_distributed.comments: Exercise typed MODE partial-state serialization across four partitions on two servers. The most frequent pallet and action user in group a never occur on the same input row.

queries.description: Global string and timestamp modes preserve the argument types
queries.sql: SET enableTypedMode=true; SELECT MODE(pallet_id), MODE(created_on) FROM {items} WHERE lpn_id = 'a'

queries.description: Grouped modes ignore nulls, retain empty strings, and break ties by the smallest value
queries.sql: SET enableTypedMode=true; SELECT lpn_id, MODE(pallet_id), MODE(created_on) FROM {items} GROUP BY lpn_id

queries.description: MODE applies independently to a stored string and computed JSON string
queries.sql: SET enableTypedMode=true; SELECT MODE(pallet_id), MODE(NULLIF(JSONEXTRACTSCALAR(meta, '$.action_user', 'STRING', ''), '')) FROM {items} WHERE lpn_id = 'a'

queries.description: Typed MAX tie reducers select the largest original value
queries.sql: SET enableTypedMode=true; SELECT MODE(pallet_id, 'MAX'), MODE(created_on, 'MAX') FROM {items} WHERE lpn_id = 'ties'

queries.description: Existing numeric modes retain DOUBLE results and MIN, MAX, and AVG reducers
queries.sql: SET enableTypedMode=true; SELECT MODE(manifest_id), MODE(manifest_id, 'MAX'), MODE(manifest_id, 'AVG') FROM {items} WHERE lpn_id = 'a'

queries.description: Computed null inputs do not become a string mode
queries.sql: SET enableTypedMode=true; SELECT MODE(NULLIF(JSONEXTRACTSCALAR(meta, '$.action_user', 'STRING', ''), '')) FROM {items} WHERE lpn_id = 'nulls'

queries.description: String expressions and post-aggregation transforms use the string result type
queries.sql: SET enableTypedMode=true; SELECT MODE(CONCAT(first_name, last_name, ' ')), UPPER(MODE(pallet_id)) FROM {items} WHERE lpn_id = 'a'

queries.description: Empty aggregate inputs return null for both types
queries.sql: SET enableTypedMode=true; SELECT MODE(pallet_id), MODE(created_on) FROM {items} WHERE lpn_id = 'missing'

queries.description: Filtered typed modes return null while preserving their group
queries.sql: SET enableTypedMode=true; SELECT lpn_id, MODE(pallet_id) FILTER (WHERE manifest_id < 0), MODE(created_on) FILTER (WHERE manifest_id < 0) FROM {items} WHERE lpn_id = 'a' GROUP BY lpn_id

queries.description: Timestamp mode can feed a parent comparison; fixture ingestion uses Los Angeles time and the SQL literal uses UTC
queries.sql: SET enableTypedMode=true; SELECT lpn_id FROM (SELECT lpn_id, MODE(created_on) AS mode_time FROM {items} GROUP BY lpn_id) WHERE mode_time = TIMESTAMP '2026-09-03 16:00:00.123'

queries.description: Joined grouping supports independent string, JSON, and timestamp modes, including unmatched outer rows
queries.sql: SET enableTypedMode=true; SELECT i.lpn_id, MODE(i.pallet_id), MODE(NULLIF(JSONEXTRACTSCALAR(i.meta, '$.action_user', 'STRING', ''), '')), MODE(m.code), MODE(m.status), MODE(m.created_on) FROM {items} i LEFT JOIN {manifests} m ON m.id = i.manifest_id GROUP BY i.lpn_id

mode_string_timestamp_direct.comments: Replicated input exercises AGGREGATE_DIRECT finalization when the physical optimizer colocates a global aggregate on one server.

queries.description: Direct aggregate emits scalar string and timestamp values instead of frequency-map intermediates
queries.sql: SET enableTypedMode=true; SELECT MODE(pallet_id), MODE(created_on) FROM {items}

queries.description: Direct aggregate with no matching values emits typed nulls
queries.sql: SET enableTypedMode=true; SELECT MODE(pallet_id) FILTER (WHERE pallet_id = 'missing'), MODE(created_on) FILTER (WHERE pallet_id = 'missing') FROM {items}
